_comment: Copy to data/settings.json and edit. Defaults run on the built-in `echo` backend, so a fresh clone works with no network and no keys.
_tiers: Tier -> backend name. Assign by latency tolerance, not importance (§3). Never point `background` at an on-device model: those passes must survive the screen going off, and only a network backend can.
_appearance: Set these in the app (gear -> Appearance) rather than here. background is a filename in static/backgrounds or "none"; background_dim is how strongly the theme colour washes over it.
_engine: Pass engine (§5). blocking_await_ms is how long the next turn waits on a late pass before proceeding on provisional state.
